description: String literals carrying newlines and escaped quotes: a single-quoted literal with an embedded newline round-trips through a VARCHAR column, a multi-line literal stores its content, an ordinary literal is unaffected, the doubled-quote escape ('') stores a single quote, and a table COMMENT may carry a newline. Converted 1:1 from features/StringLiteralTest (now retired).

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE test_strings (id INTEGER, text VARCHAR)
SELECT text FROM test_strings WHERE id = 1

SELECT CONTAINS(text, CHAR(10)) OR CONTAINS(text, '
') FROM test_strings WHERE id = 1
CREATE TABLE test_multiline (id INTEGER, content VARCHAR)

INSERT INTO test_multiline VALUES (1, 'First line
Second line
Third line')
SELECT content FROM test_multiline WHERE id = 1
SELECT IFF(content IS NULL, 'null', 'set') FROM test_multiline WHERE id = 1
CREATE TABLE test_simple (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR)
SELECT name FROM test_simple WHERE id = 1
CREATE TABLE test_escaped (id INTEGER, text VARCHAR)
SELECT text FROM test_escaped WHERE id = 1

CREATE TABLE test_comment (id INTEGER) COMMENT = 'This is a comment
with a newline'
